tools.name: find_airport
tools.description: Search airports by city, name or IATA code. Returns up to 8 matches with their IATA codes; Canadian airports are listed first.

tools.name: find_airline
tools.description: Find an airline’s 2-character code from a flight number (e.g. "AC 857") or a name (e.g. "WestJet"). An airline missing from the list can still be checked by its code.

tools.name: check_flight_compensation
tools.description: Check whether an airline owes cash compensation for a delayed or cancelled flight under Canada's Air Passenger Protection Regulations, and how much. Ask the passenger for every answer; don't guess. Returns the verdict, amount per passenger and the last day to file. General information, not legal adv
